summary: This Foxglove blog tutorial by José L. Millán explains how to use ROS 1 launch files to run, configure, and namespace multiple nodes with a single command. It walks through a sense-think-act example with sensor_node, compute_node and motor_node, adds namespaces, includes a robot_node from the params_pkg package with parameters loaded from a YAML file, and shows monitoring with Foxglove Studio panels. The post links to the foxglove/tutorials GitHub repo for the code.
one_line: Tutorial on using ROS 1 launch files to run, configure, and namespace multiple nodes at once, with Foxglove Studio monitoring.
key_facts: The tutorial was published October 31, 2022 by José L. Millán and takes about 9 minutes to read.
Launch files let users execute and configure multiple ROS 1 nodes with a single command.
The example robot follows a "sense-think-act" model with sensor_node, compute_node and motor_node.
The sensor_node reads distance data, compute_node sends commands to the wheels, and motor_node outputs voltage to the motors.
The launch file is named launch_example.launch.py and is placed in a launch folder of the launch_pkg package.
Nodes are declared in the launch file with the node tag, using attributes such as pkg, type, name and output="screen".
Adding ns="sense_think_act" to the node tags places the three nodes and their topics in that namespace.
A node has only one name but can belong to multiple levels of namespaces, joined with a forward slash.
The robot_node from the ROS 1 parameters tutorial is included from params_pkg using the rosparam load command with warehouseA_core.yaml.
The robot_node is placed in the "core" namespace and reports that its name is RobotA with a max speed of 1.4.
The robot_node follows waypoints listed as Home, Corridor, Home.
The launch file is run with the command roslaunch launch_pkg launch_example.launch.py on ROS 1 Noetic (rosversion 1.15.14).
Foxglove Studio's Topic Graph panel is used to check that nodes and topics are running and carry their namespaces.
The post's code is available in the foxglove/tutorials GitHub repository under ros1/launch.
